answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by locking collateral in an auditor vault. An attacker creating dense puppet clusters suffers superlinear attacker cost as graph partition density spikes. In our testbeds, nodes like crystal or yarrow stake tokens to cross-audit peer cuts, rendering large-scale Sybil floods economically unviable.
